text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to stay consistent every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. In the evening, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. Then I relax, cook dinner, and spend some time reading or watching TV. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel organized, healthy, and energetic.
